description: This is a React component for a roadmapping feature within a Next.js web application. It manages role-based skill delta analysis and milestone tracking for career planning, including state management, UI rendering, and local storage persistence.

methods.name: safeParseStringArray
methods.description: Safely parses a JSON string into a string array, returning an empty array on failure or invalid input.

methods.name: uid
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random unique identifier string with a given prefix.

methods.name: clamp
methods.description: Clamps a number between specified minimum and maximum bounds.

methods.name: todayISO
methods.description: Returns the current date in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

methods.name: ProgressPill
methods.description: A React component that displays a colored pill representing a percentage value.

methods.name: StatusChip
methods.description: A React component that displays the status of a milestone with color coding.

methods.name: seedRolePlan
methods.description: Creates a placeholder role plan with default skill deltas and milestones based on role id.

methods.name: loadRoadmapState
methods.description: Loads the roadmap state (active role ID and plans) from local storage.

methods.name: persistRoadmapState
methods.description: Saves the current roadmap state to local storage.
